title: Mystical Glowing Pyramid
description: A glowing triangular pyramid constructed from multicolored crystalline orbs sits centrally on a dark surface. The structure is wrapped in intricate golden alchemical and runic symbols, emitting warm orange and red light from within against a dark, stormy background filled with colorful bokeh orbs.
